references.text: Jacob adopted Ephraim and Manasseh as his own sons, giving them inheritance rights equal to his other sons
The birth of Joseph's two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim, in Egypt, who later received an inheritance in Canaan
Joseph's sons Manasseh and Ephraim are mentioned as founders of the tribes that would receive land territories
Joseph's descendants became two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim, both of whom received an inheritance
Joseph's descendants complained that they received only one share, so Joshua gave them more land
Jacob's blessing over Ephraim and Manasseh, where Ephraim was placed before Manasseh
